For those new to survival games and want to enjoy a relaxing life with their Pals!
・Pals are easier to catch, you gain more EXP, and you can gather resources and incubate eggs faster.
・Battles become much easier.
・There are no penalties when dying.

For survival game regulars who want to take on the challenge of survival on Palpagos Island!
・Standard game balance.
・Upon death, all equipment and material items are dropped on the spot.
fields.WORLDSSETTING_Difficulty_Hard_Desc:
For survival game veterans.
Face off against an onslaught of ferocious wild Pals and the unforgiving elements of Palpagos Island.
・Pals are harder to catch, you gain less EXP, and gathering resources and incubating eggs takes longer.
・The player takes more damage and deals less damage.
・Upon death, all items and Pals are dropped on the spot.

fields.PALRECRUIT_CARREER_TEXT_1: Has gone its whole life without lifting a finger, driven purely by primal instinct.
fields.PALRECRUIT_CARREER_TEXT_2: Drifted from herd to herd, never managing to stay in one place for long.
fields.PALRECRUIT_CARREER_TEXT_3: Spent its life solo, only now beginning to understand the importance of friends.
fields.PALRECRUIT_CARREER_TEXT_4: A born adventurer, traveled the world since it was little.
fields.PALRECRUIT_CARREER_TEXT_5: Former slacker, has finally begun to get its act together.
fields.PALRECRUIT_CARREER_TEXT_6: Having lived a laid-back life in a peaceful place, it's not well-versed in battle.
fields.PALRECRUIT_CARREER_TEXT_7: Once famed as a warrior in its youth, it now seeks a quiet life.
fields.PALRECRUIT_CARREER_TEXT_8: A natural troublemaker, driven by boundless youthful curiosity.
fields.PALRECRUIT_CARREER_TEXT_9: Used to lead a herd until one day, it cast everything aside for freedom.
fields.PALRECRUIT_CARREER_TEXT_10: Though it used to be in the service of nobility, it now shows no sign of its former station.
fields.PALRECRUIT_CARREER_TEXT_11: It was raised among many others, and thrives on coordination and group effort.
fields.PALRECRUIT_CARREER_TEXT_12: Once deeply shaken by failure, it's now forging ahead with renewed purpose.
fields.PALRECRUIT_CARREER_TEXT_13: Obsessed with eating, it chases the gourmet life with single-minded passion.
fields.PALRECRUIT_CARREER_TEXT_14: Tired of fleeing, it has finally decided to stand its ground.
fields.PALRECRUIT_CARREER_TEXT_15: A veil of secrecy surrounds its past, known to none.
fields.PALRECRUIT_CARREER_TEXT_16: Has dozed through most of its life, driven by an endless love of sleep.
fields.PALRECRUIT_CARREER_TEXT_17: Not a fan of labor, but puts in surprising effort when asked.
fields.PALRECRUIT_CARREER_TEXT_18: Finds purpose in looking after the group and being there for everyone.
fields.PALRECRUIT_CARREER_TEXT_19: Once celebrated for its combat prowess, it now wanders with no ties.
fields.PALRECRUIT_CARREER_TEXT_20: A traveler from birth, it has long forgotten its homeland.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_1: Convinced itself that being unremarkable is what makes it unique.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_PAL_FullS: Its fixation on dieting led it to reject the very idea of eating.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_Deffence_: Too thick-skinned for even a syringe to pierce.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_CraftSpee: The kind who finishes one job only to be handed three more.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_PAL_ALLAt: Finds pleasure in brute force and watching its enemies quake with fear.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_MoveSpeed: So fast you can barely see it move.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_PAL_Sanit: Its mental fortitude is so extreme that neither insults nor praise will phase it.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_PAL_FullS: Has a long track record of shedding weight only to gain it all back just as quickly.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_Deffence_: Loves pumping iron and never misses a chance to flex its muscles.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_SalePrice: Born with natural grace, it shines no matter where it goes.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_CraftSpee: Takes pride in meticulous work and accepts nothing less than perfection.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_PAL_ALLAt: Wild and aggressive. It proudly claims to have never lost a single fight.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_Noukin: Thinking's not its strong suit, so it lets its strength do the talking.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_MoveSpeed: A rolling stone, restless and aimless.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_TrainerAT: The life of the battlefield, always boosting morale with its enthusiasm.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_TrainerDE: A gifted strategist who prioritizes defense and puts everyone at ease.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_TrainerWo: Just being near this Pal somehow fills you with motivation.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_TrainerMi: Digging is its hobby; it treasures every pebble like a rare gem.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_TrainerLo: Treats every tree like its own mortal enemy.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_Vampire: Oddly nocturnal and fixated on anything with the color red.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_Test_PalE: Has a gift for bonding with others, but tends to overdo it when it comes to physical affection.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_Stamina_U: Boasts that it can keep working for days on end without rest.
Can work all day without breaking a sweat and resents being told to rest.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_CoolTimeR: Even-keeled and indifferent, it always keeps a cool head.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_PAL_Sanit: A total workaholic that gets restless when it's not on its daily grind.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_PAL_FullS: A light eater who always judges others' hearty appetites.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_Deffence_: Has skin so thick that it puts even <characterName id=|LazyCatfish|/> to shame.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_PAL_masoc: These days, it takes more than a little pain to feel satisfied.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_ElementBo: Always brags that it never gets distracted...which is, ironically, a distraction in itself.
Can't help getting fired up whenever it sees flames.
Totally the type to act out and splash around in the bath.
Because it loves all things electric, it has a strange fondness for electronic devices.
Finds comfort in nature and has a fondness for the smell of greenery.
Keeps its emotions hidden, making it hard to read.
Gains energy simply by being on solid ground. No one knows why.
Truly thrives after sunset, a classic creature of the night.
One hundred percent sure it's a dragon, no questions asked.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_ElementRe: Believes it's unique, though it can't quite articulate how.
Loves the sun and proudly boasts UV-resistant skin.
Absolutely refuses to get wet, turning sour the second raindrops begin to fall.
Seems to have lived a life untouched by static electricity.
Has such a strong aversion to plants that its territory is completely free of weeds.
Hates the cold and is always on the lookout for warm spots.
Has a rock-solid disposition, unshaken by even the most violent quakes.
Their endless optimism can be a bit much for those around them.
Thanks to a deep hatred of dragons, it knows just what to do in case of an attack.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_SalePrice: Takes great pride in its fur, never skipping its meticulous daily grooming routine.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_CraftSpee: A stickler for rules, often too inflexible for its own good.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_PAL_conce: Has a huge ego, and stroking with praise only makes it worse.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_PAL_Corpo: The type that works simply for the sake of it.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_PAL_ALLAt: Takes on all danger without a second thought. Call it bravery...or foolishness.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_PAL_rude: Brawny and short-fused, it's no stranger to causing a scene.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_PAL_sadis: A bit of a troublemaker that takes delight in others' confusion.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_PAL_oraor: Comes off as domineering, but is unexpectedly helpful when it counts.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_MoveSpeed: Its speed makes it notoriously difficult to pin down.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_Nocturnal: Bursting with energy at night, it is often found roaming under the moon.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_NonKillin: Skilled in subduing foes without killing. An expert in the art of the near-death blow.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_Stamina_U: Proud of its perfect health, never once having fallen sick.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_CoolTimeR: Too impatient for its own good...which often backfires.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_PAL_Sanit: Always believes |it'll all work out.| It might be an optimist—but it's more likely that it just doesn't think things through.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_PAL_FullS: Perpetually starving. Food is the only thing on its mind.
Thanks to a stomach that defies space and time, its appetite knows no bounds.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_SalePrice: Often underestimated due to its simple appearance.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_CraftSpee: Has a hard time with precise tasks...and it often shows.
Convinced that the only way to fail in life is by taking things too seriously.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_PAL_ALLAt: Lives in constant fear, but hey, that's what keeps it alive.
Dislikes conflict and tends to avoid fights.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_Stamina_D: Prefers the comfort of its territory and rarely ventures out.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_CoolTimeR: Moves through life unhurried, often losing track of time.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_PAL_Spiri: Easily shaken, even by the tiniest surprises.
fields.PALRECRUIT_APPEAL_TEXT_DEFAULT_PAL_Sanit: Consumed by total despair, it wanders in search of a final resting place.
